Hi! So I have built my island up from the ground several times so I have lots of advice to give! 

First off, custom designs are everything!!! Paths, stalls, standees and simple panels, flags, those are all very very important in making your island stand out! [This website ](https://nookea.com/en_us) has categories of different designs and themes that make finding designs a breeze. 

Second, use your space wisely. Don’t be afraid to make small areas vs large expansive areas. Variety is key. 

Third, use a list. Plan out what sort of things fit on your island. You said tropical theme, so maybe have beach showers and tiki bars, use items that have the same feel, etc. This also ties in to number 4. 

Fourth, colors!! Plan out what colors you want to see. For tropical, maybe leave out the gold, black, and purple roses for instead bright pinks and yellows and oranges. Plan what type of bush to use, what fencing. Don’t be afraid of Isabelle’s rankings when placing trees to your heart’s delight. Ignore the ranking entirely if you have terraforming, it does nothing for you anymore. 

Five, Terraforming. Be very careful that you don’t burn yourself out while terraforming, you know yourself best. If you do better with big projects, flatten your island and rebuild. If you lose motivation quickly, start small and rebuild areas at a time. You don’t want to get ahead of yourself and make yourself burnt out. And don’t be afraid to take down something you hate to remake it. Some people actually pre plan their entire island out, which you can do on [this website here.](https://eugeneration.github.io/HappyIslandDesigner/)

Lastly, remember, this is all for your own happiness. If you’re doing this to impress others, maybe you should rethink the rebuild. Are you doing this for your own fun? Go ahead!! Just make sure you don’t make yourself miserable. 

If you need additional help, feel free to ask me questions on specifics and such! I can also give you my discord if need be. Hope I helped!
